description:
Solution architect that creates implementation blueprints before building.
Use when: (1) "architect this", "design a solution", "blueprint for",
(2) Taking a task from the audit report and need an implementation plan,
(3) "how should I build this?", "plan before building",
(4) Before any non-trivial implementation.
Reads from system/audit-report.md. Outputs to system/blueprints/.
